description: This header file defines interfaces for Wi-Fi generator MLD (Multicast Listener Discovery) functions, including fetching, selecting, and reconfiguring SSIDs related to Wi-Fi links within a plugin module.

methods.name: wifiGen_mld_fetchSockLinkSSID
methods.description: Fetches the SSID associated with a socket link managed by the wld wpaCtrl manager.

methods.name: wifiGen_mld_selectPrimLinkSSID
methods.description: Selects the primary SSID from a list of SSIDs.

methods.name: wifiGen_mld_reconfigureNeighLinkSSIDs
methods.description: Reconfigures neighbor link SSIDs based on the provided SSID.
